summary: Independent design review of frozen amended specification e3fcf4e6c3f13aef834d71be2e10b4947098311e383b5bb100bdf74d183ddd85, actual regenerated design context cba2b62e0f40f2d852badd54863ed4f1e27868563c62552ddd7b3d5417a3b04c and design amendment 003. The additional production scope is limited to pure YAML text decoding in document_parsing and its existing policy/storage callers, with corresponding unit tests. The design keeps every caller path guard and current UTF-8 file read, current schema validation, Policy cross-file semantics, canonical hashing, identity/freshness/state/approval decision and original error translation outside the cache and live on every call. The cache binds the full current text, retains at most 64 eligible entries with a 16384-character per-text limit, uses independent copied results on every eligible return, and preserves intra-result alias topology, cycles and standard SafeLoader date/value types without exposing retained mutable graphs. Unchanged file size or restored mtime cannot substitute for actual content. Parser/configuration changes and unsupported custom values must bypass retained entries and use the original current safe_load path; unsupported copying must fall back to the current parse without caching failures or introducing a new caller-visible exception. Required boundary verification covers deletion/path escape/corrupt text after a hit, live schema and cross-Policy rejection, deep mutation isolation, same-size content drift, aliases/cycles/date values, repeated parse failures, size/capacity eviction and parser/configuration/custom-value fallback. These are implementation acceptance obligations, not verified behavior in this review. No blocking design issue found. Complete run003 remains FAILED, and overlapping profiling time does not establish its timeout cause. Python 3.14 compatibility failure remains preserved and outside this repair; formal validation stays on the actual Python 3.11 baseline. Original assertions, selectors, environment whitelist/MINENV, Policy, schemas, workflows, thresholds, budgets, fixed targeted mutation and independent native V2 requirements remain unchanged. Complete unchanged-module measurement precedes full V2; microbenchmarks or module success do not replace it. Prior frozen design, failures, approvals, Review records, logs and consumed receipts remain traceable; subsequent execution requires a fresh exact action. This approves only the frozen design: this real reviewer has not authored production/tests, implemented or tested the cache, recorded a canonical Review, approved the specification, finalized verification or published changes. Implementation Review, finalize, current code approval, Gate and required complete CI remain necessary.
